six.with_metaclass detection broken for classes with multiple inheritance

#### Description

When using `six.with_metaclass` with classes that have multiple base classes, the metaclass detection fails and the class hierarchy is not properly resolved.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import six
import astroid

# This should work but doesn't
code = '''
import six

class WithMeta(six.with_metaclass(type, object, SomeOtherBase)):
    pass
'''

module = astroid.parse(code)
klass = module.body[1]  # Get the class definition
print("Ancestors:", [base.name for base in klass.ancestors()])
print("Metaclass:", klass.metaclass().name if klass.metaclass() else None)
```

The metaclass detection logic seems to fail when there are multiple base classes in the inheritance chain. The issue appears to be related to how the `six.with_metaclass` pattern is detected and processed.

Also affects cases where the class uses different forms of six imports:

```python
from six import with_metaclass

class MultipleInheritance(with_metaclass(type, BaseA, BaseB)):
    pass
```
</issue>
